item.title: 3 memorabilia ni Manny Pacquiao swak sa Philippine Sports Museum

item.title: Pabibo agad! JM Ronquillo, Protectors tiniris Cabstars

item.title: Mikee Santos hanep sabak! De La Salle kinalos Peyups

item.title: Digong pinayagan ng ICC `umabsent’ sa detention hearing
